title: Grade 4 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — General Assessment #9

pages.quiz:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #9
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A game is permitted in Islam if (1 mark)
   A. It is safe, fair and does not stop us from prayer
   B. It hurts people
   C. It involves betting
   D. It uses bad words

2. Which of these is a Sunnah act, not a pillar? (1 mark)
   A. Fatiha
   B. Ruku
   C. Sujud
   D. Raising hands with the first takbir

3. Which angel brings revelation to the prophets? (1 mark)
   A. Jibril
   B. Mikail
   C. Malakul Maut
   D. Israfil

4. How many pillars of Iman are there? (1 mark)
   A. Five
   B. Ten
   C. Six
   D. Seven

5. Why should clothes not carry rude words or pictures? (1 mark)
   A. They are cheap
   B. They disrespect faith and others
   C. They fade
   D. They are heavy

6. How should parents correct children? (1 mark)
   A. By ignoring
   B. By insults
   C. With wisdom and gentleness
   D. With cruelty

7. Kevin returns a lost charger when nobody sees him. Which belief helped him? (1 mark)
   A. Allah is a picture
   B. Allah is Al-Basir, the All-Seeing
   C. Nobody cares
   D. Allah is far away

8. What is Taif known for? (1 mark)
   A. Cooler weather, gardens and fruit
   B. Beaches
   C. Snow
   D. Deserts only

9. What does "Al-Amin" mean? (1 mark)
   A. The trustworthy
   B. The strong
   C. The tall
   D. The rich

10. The Kiswahili word for the tooth-cleaning stick or brush is (1 mark)
   A. Kofia
   B. Mkeka
   C. Kanzu
   D. Mswaki

11. A friend gives you back too much change by mistake. What would a person of the Prophet's character do? (1 mark)
   A. Keep it quietly
   B. Spend it on sweets
   C. Return the extra money
   D. Tell others to do the same

12. Which of these is bad eating manners? (1 mark)
   A. Talking with a full mouth
   B. Waiting for elders
   C. Sitting calmly
   D. Taking small bites

13. How far are the feet washed? (1 mark)
   A. Knees
   B. Heels only
   C. Toes only
   D. Up to and including the ankles

14. Why are parents to be respected? (1 mark)
   A. They are rich
   B. They are tall
   C. They sacrifice time, energy and money for us
   D. They are old only

15. Which subject helps you find directions with a compass? (1 mark)
   A. Social Studies
   B. Music
   C. Art
   D. Cookery only

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. State three times when it is recommended to be in wudhu. (3 marks)

17. Give the meanings of Ar-Rahman, Ar-Rahim and Al-Malik. (3 marks)

18. What should a child do when two cousins quarrel? (3 marks)

19. State two ways to know the times of prayer. (2 marks)

20. State the duties of Malakul Maut and of Raqib and Atid. (2 marks)

21. State two lessons from Surah An-Nasr. (2 marks)
pages.answers:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #9 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. A — It is safe, fair and does not stop us from prayer
   These are the conditions.

2. D — Raising hands with the first takbir
   Sunnah acts add reward.

3. A — Jibril
   Jibril brought the Qur'an to the Prophet.

4. C — Six
   There are six pillars of Iman.

5. B — They disrespect faith and others
   Clothes should be modest.

6. C — With wisdom and gentleness
   Islam forbids cruelty.

7. B — Allah is Al-Basir, the All-Seeing
   He knows Allah sees everything.

8. A — Cooler weather, gardens and fruit
   It is on higher ground.

9. A — The trustworthy
   The people of Makkah called Muhammad Al-Amin.

10. D — Mswaki
   Mswaki means toothbrush or chewing stick.

11. C — Return the extra money
   Honesty means returning what is not yours.

12. A — Talking with a full mouth
   Chewing with the mouth open and talking is impolite.

13. D — Up to and including the ankles
   To the ankles.

14. C — They sacrifice time, energy and money for us
   Gratitude.

15. A — Social Studies
   Social Studies teaches direction finding.

SECTION B
----
16. (3 marks)
   Answer: Before prayer, before touching the Qur'an, before sleeping, before reciting Qur'an.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

17. (3 marks)
   Answer: Ar-Rahman: the Most Kind; Ar-Rahim: the Most Merciful; Al-Malik: the King and Owner.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

18. (3 marks)
   Answer: Stay calm, encourage them to forgive and make peace, and ask an elder if needed.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for calm, 1 mark for peace, 1 mark for asking elders.

19. (2 marks)
   Answer: Adhan, printed mosque timetable, prayer app, watching the sun.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

20. (2 marks)
   Answer: Malakul Maut takes souls at death. Raqib and Atid record our deeds.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

21. (2 marks)
   Answer: We should thank Allah and be humble when we succeed, and ask His forgiveness.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each lesson.
